name: Disruption Ammunition
text:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Disruption ammunition consists of alchemically treated metal, the surface of which roils like the thrashings of a writhing parasite trapped within. When activated disruption ammunition hits a target, it attempts to counteract one active spell effect that the target is Sustaining with a +11 counteract check modifier (counteract rank 3).
